active_set_rule_declared.applied_to: candidate AND null, identically, once per fold
active_set_rule_declared.rationale: P33/P35 A14 fallback: term enters a fold iff >= 10 training clusters have exp_i = 1 (card, verbatim; single_active_fold_licensing_amended / FOLDS F6: S7_TIER_SUPPORT_v1 registered via registry append). Because league_common_decay > 0 for every finite n_i, cluster support of expansion_decay_interaction equals cluster support of exp_i = 1 exactly, so this single ActiveSetRule instance, fed the treatment column, is a complete expression of the card's one-sided rule.
